```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# county risk data
risk_df <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv"
)

# phenology data
phen_df <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Temporal Data/merged_monthly_phen_scaled_clean.csv"
)

# reshape risk to long format
risk_long <- risk_df %>%
  dplyr::select(County, Risk_is_scaled, Risk_dv_scaled, Risk_aa_scaled) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Risk"),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "RR"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = dplyr::case_when(
    species == "Risk_is_scaled" ~ "is",
    species == "Risk_dv_scaled" ~ "dv",
    species == "Risk_aa_scaled" ~ "aa"
  ))

# reshape phenology to long
phen_long <- phen_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::ends_with("phen_scal"),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "phen"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = dplyr::case_when(
    species == "is_phen_scal" ~ "is",
    species == "dv_phen_scal" ~ "dv",
    species == "aa_phen_scal" ~ "aa"
  ))

# rename species columns first
risk_long2 <- risk_long %>%
  dplyr::rename(species_risk = species)

phen_long2 <- phen_long %>%
  dplyr::rename(species_phen = species)

# cross join and keep matching species only
final_df <- risk_long2 %>%
  tidyr::crossing(phen_long2) %>%
  dplyr::filter(species_risk == species_phen) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Seasonal_Risk = RR * phen
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    County,
    Month,
    species = species_risk,
    RR,
    phen,
    Seasonal_Risk
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(County, species, Month)

#Export
write.csv(
  final_df,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Monthly risk/county_monthly_risk_long_formate.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# make Month an ordered factor so columns stay Jan to Dec
final_df <- final_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Month = factor(
      Month,
      levels = c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                 "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")
    )
  )

# create wide dataframe: one row per county, one column per month-species
final_wide <- final_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(month_species = paste(as.character(Month), species, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(County, month_species, Seasonal_Risk) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = month_species,
    values_from = Seasonal_Risk
  )

# optional: arrange columns exactly how you want
final_wide <- final_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    County,
    Jan_aa, Feb_aa, Mar_aa, Apr_aa, May_aa, Jun_aa, Jul_aa, Aug_aa, Sep_aa, Oct_aa, Nov_aa, Dec_aa,
    Jan_dv, Feb_dv, Mar_dv, Apr_dv, May_dv, Jun_dv, Jul_dv, Aug_dv, Sep_dv, Oct_dv, Nov_dv, Dec_dv,
    Jan_is, Feb_is, Mar_is, Apr_is, May_is, Jun_is, Jul_is, Aug_is, Sep_is, Oct_is, Nov_is, Dec_is
  )

#View(final_wide)

##Join this with regional classification of counties (north, south, central)

region_df <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/County classification/Regional classification of counties.csv")

clean_names <- function(x) {
  tolower(gsub("\\s+", "", x))   # remove spaces only, keep dots
}

final_wide <- final_wide %>%
  mutate(County = clean_names(County))

region_df <- region_df %>%
  mutate(County = clean_names(County)) %>%
  select(County, Region)

final_wide <- final_wide %>%
  left_join(region_df, by = "County")

# View(final_wide)
write.csv(
  final_wide,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Monthly risk/county_monthly_risk_wide_formate.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```


## Convertig nuerial values into quntile catagories
```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

file_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Monthly risk/county_monthly_risk_wide_formate.csv"

out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Monthly risk"

final_wide <- read_csv(file_path)

risk_cols <- c(
  "Jan_aa","Feb_aa","Mar_aa","Apr_aa","May_aa","Jun_aa","Jul_aa","Aug_aa","Sep_aa","Oct_aa","Nov_aa","Dec_aa",
  "Jan_dv","Feb_dv","Mar_dv","Apr_dv","May_dv","Jun_dv","Jul_dv","Aug_dv","Sep_dv","Oct_dv","Nov_dv","Dec_dv",
  "Jan_is","Feb_is","Mar_is","Apr_is","May_is","Jun_is","Jul_is","Aug_is","Sep_is","Oct_is","Nov_is","Dec_is"
)

risk_levels <- c("very low", "low", "medium", "high", "very high")

final_wide <- final_wide %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(risk_cols),
      ~ cut(
        .x,
        breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.10, 0.30, 0.60, 1.00),
        labels = risk_levels,
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        right = TRUE
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_cat"
    )
  )
write_csv(
  final_wide,
  file.path(out_dir, "county_monthly_risk_wide_formate_with_categories.csv")
)
```


## Joining with shape file
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Import shapefile
IL_shape <- st_read("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Illinois_shape_file/IL_BNDY_County_Py.shp")

# Standardize shapefile county key, but do not keep extra county columns in final join
IL_shape <- IL_shape %>%
  select(geometry, COUNTY_NAM) %>%
  mutate(
    County_std = COUNTY_NAM %>%
      str_to_lower() %>%
      str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
  )

# Standardize county key in final_wide
final_wide <- final_wide %>%
  mutate(
    County = County %>%
      str_to_lower() %>%
      str_replace_all("\\s+", ""),
    County_std = County
  )

# Join and keep only one county column
Final_Risk_sf <- IL_shape %>%
  left_join(final_wide, by = "County_std") %>%
  select(-COUNTY_NAM, -County_std) %>%
  select(County, everything())


colnames(Final_Risk_sf)

sum(is.na(Final_Risk_sf$Jan_aa))
sum(is.na(Final_Risk_sf$Jan_dv))
sum(is.na(Final_Risk_sf$Jan_is))

#View(Final_Risk_sf)

```



##Interactive Plotting
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

Final_Risk_sf <- Final_Risk_sf %>%
  st_transform(4326)

IL_outline <- Final_Risk_sf %>%
  summarise() %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()

month_levels <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                  "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

risk_levels <- c("very low", "low", "medium", "high", "very high")

risk_palette <- c(
  "very low"  = "#deebf7",
  "low"       = "#3182bd",
  "medium"    = "#feb24c",
  "high"      = "#f03b20",
  "very high" = "#bd0026"
)

risk_labels <- risk_levels

range_box <- HTML(
  paste0(
    "<div style='background:white;padding:8px;border:1px solid #bbb;",
    "border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);",
    "font-size:13px; width:360px;'>",
    
    "<details>",
    "<summary style='cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; color:#2c3e50;'>How to interpret</summary>",
    
    "<div style='margin-top:6px; line-height:1.5;'>",
    "Values range from 0 to 1 and show the relative level of tick-related disease activity across counties.<br><br>",
    
    "&#8226; <b>Very low</b> (0.00–0.05): Very little disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>Low</b> (0.05–0.10): Low disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>Medium</b> (0.10–0.30): Moderate disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>High</b> (0.30–0.60): High disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>Very high</b> (&gt;0.60): Very high disease activity<br><br>",
    
    "These values are relative and allow comparison between counties. ",
    "They do not represent individual risk or probability of infection.",
    "</div>",
    
    "</details>",
    "</div>"
  )
)
make_month_map_cat <- function(sf_obj, species_code, species_title) {
  
  month_cols <- paste0(month_levels, "_", species_code, "_cat")
  value_cols <- paste0(month_levels, "_", species_code)
  
  pal <- colorFactor(
    palette = risk_palette,
    levels = risk_levels,
    ordered = TRUE,
    na.color = "transparent"
  )
  
  m <- leaflet(sf_obj) %>%
  addTiles()
  
  for (i in seq_along(month_levels)) {
    mo <- month_levels[i]
    cat_col <- month_cols[i]
    val_col <- value_cols[i]
    
    tmp <- sf_obj %>%
      mutate(
        map_value = factor(.data[[cat_col]], levels = risk_levels, ordered = TRUE),
        num_value = .data[[val_col]],
        map_month = mo
      )
    
    m <- m %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = tmp,
        group = mo,
        fillColor = ~pal(map_value),
        fillOpacity = 0.85,
        color = "#9E9E9E",   # slim gray county borders
        weight = 0.35,
        opacity = 1,
        smoothFactor = 0.2,
        popup = ~paste0(
          "<b>County:</b> ", County, "<br>",
          "<b>Species:</b> ", species_title, "<br>",
          "<b>Month:</b> ", map_month, "<br>",
          "<b>Value:</b> ", round(num_value, 4), "<br>",
          "<b>Category:</b> ", map_value
        )
      )
  }
  
  for (mo in month_levels[-1]) {
    m <- m %>% hideGroup(mo)
  }
  
  m %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = IL_outline,
      fill = FALSE,
      color = "black",   # dark Illinois boundary
      weight = 0.75,
      opacity = 1
    ) %>%
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      colors = unname(risk_palette),
      labels = risk_labels,
      title = HTML(paste0("<b>", species_title, "</b><br>Category")),
      opacity = 0.9
    ) %>%
    addControl(
      html = range_box,
      position = "bottomleft"
    ) %>%
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = month_levels,
      position = "topright",
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
}

map_aa <- make_month_map_cat(Final_Risk_sf, "aa", "Amblyomma americanum")
map_dv <- make_month_map_cat(Final_Risk_sf, "dv", "Dermacentor variabilis")
map_is <- make_month_map_cat(Final_Risk_sf, "is", "Ixodes scapularis")

map_aa
map_dv
map_is

```


## Smoothing
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(spdep)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Build queen contiguity spatial weights from your existing Final_Risk_sf
nb <- poly2nb(Final_Risk_sf, queen = TRUE)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Define month levels and all 36 numeric risk column names
month_levels <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                  "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

risk_cols_num <- c(
  paste0(month_levels, "_aa"),
  paste0(month_levels, "_dv"),
  paste0(month_levels, "_is")
)

# Apply spatial lag smoothing and store as new columns with _smooth suffix
# Original columns are NOT touched or replaced
for (col in risk_cols_num) {
  Final_Risk_sf[[paste0(col, "_smooth")]] <- lag.listw(
    lw,
    Final_Risk_sf[[col]],
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )
}

# Define risk levels and breaks for categorization
risk_levels <- c("very low", "low", "medium", "high", "very high")

risk_cols_smooth <- paste0(risk_cols_num, "_smooth")

# Categorize each smoothed column and store as new _smooth_cat columns
# Wide sf object now has original, smooth numeric, and smooth category columns all separate
Final_Risk_sf <- Final_Risk_sf %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(risk_cols_smooth),
      ~ cut(
        as.numeric(.x),
        breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.10, 0.30, 0.60, 1.00),
        labels = risk_levels,
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        right = TRUE
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_cat"
    )
  )

# Define color palette and labels for the five risk categories
risk_palette <- c(
  "very low"  = "#deebf7",
  "low"       = "#3182bd",
  "medium"    = "#feb24c",
  "high"      = "#f03b20",
  "very high" = "#bd0026"
)

risk_labels <- risk_levels

# Build the Illinois outer boundary for the black state outline
IL_outline <- Final_Risk_sf %>%
  summarise() %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Interpretive info box shown on bottom left of each map
range_box <- HTML(
  paste0(
    "<div style='background:white;padding:8px;border:1px solid #bbb;",
    "border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);",
    "font-size:13px; width:360px;'>",
    "<details>",
    "<summary style='cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; color:#2c3e50;'>How to interpret</summary>",
    "<div style='margin-top:6px; line-height:1.5;'>",
    "Values range from 0 to 1 and show the relative level of tick-related disease activity across counties.<br><br>",
    "&#8226; <b>Very low</b> (0.00 to 0.01): Very little disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>Low</b> (0.01 to 0.10): Low disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>Medium</b> (0.10 to 0.30): Moderate disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>High</b> (0.30 to 0.60): High disease activity<br>",
    "&#8226; <b>Very high</b> (above 0.60): Very high disease activity<br><br>",
    "Values are spatially smoothed using queen contiguity spatial lag. ",
    "They are relative and allow comparison between counties. ",
    "They do not represent individual risk or probability of infection.",
    "</div>",
    "</details>",
    "</div>"
  )
)

# Function to build one interactive smoothed map for a given tick species
# Uses _smooth columns for color and _smooth_cat for category display
# Original raw values also shown in popup for reference
make_smooth_map <- function(sf_obj, species_code, species_title) {

  month_cat_cols  <- paste0(month_levels, "_", species_code, "_smooth_cat")
  month_num_cols  <- paste0(month_levels, "_", species_code, "_smooth")
  month_orig_cols <- paste0(month_levels, "_", species_code)

  pal <- colorFactor(
    palette  = risk_palette,
    levels   = risk_levels,
    ordered  = TRUE,
    na.color = "transparent"
  )

  m <- leaflet(sf_obj) %>%
  addTiles()

  for (i in seq_along(month_levels)) {

    mo       <- month_levels[i]
    cat_col  <- month_cat_cols[i]
    num_col  <- month_num_cols[i]
    orig_col <- month_orig_cols[i]

    tmp <- sf_obj %>%
      mutate(
        map_cat   = factor(.data[[cat_col]],  levels = risk_levels, ordered = TRUE),
        map_num   = .data[[num_col]],
        map_orig  = .data[[orig_col]],
        map_month = mo
      )

    m <- m %>%
      addPolygons(
        data         = tmp,
        group        = mo,
        fillColor    = ~pal(map_cat),
        fillOpacity  = 0.85,
        color        = "#9E9E9E",
        weight       = 0.35,
        opacity      = 1,
        smoothFactor = 0.2,
        popup = ~paste0(
  "<b>County:</b> ",   County,             "<br>",
  "<b>Species:</b> ",  species_title,      "<br>",
  "<b>Month:</b> ",    map_month,          "<br>",
  "<b>Value:</b> ",    round(map_num, 4),  "<br>",
  "<b>Category:</b> ", map_cat
)
      )
  }

  for (mo in month_levels[-1]) {
    m <- m %>% hideGroup(mo)
  }

  m %>%
    addPolygons(
      data    = IL_outline,
      fill    = FALSE,
      color   = "black",
      weight  = 0.75,
      opacity = 1
    ) %>%
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      colors   = unname(risk_palette),
      labels   = risk_labels,
     title = HTML(paste0(
  "<div style='min-width:180px; line-height:1.8;'>",
  "<span style='display:block; white-space:nowrap;'><i>", species_title, "</i></span>",
  "<span style='display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px;'>Category</span>",
  "</div>"
)),
      opacity  = 0.9
    ) %>%
    addControl(
      html     = range_box,
      position = "bottomleft"
    ) %>%
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = month_levels,
      position   = "topright",
      options    = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
}

# Build the three smoothed interactive maps
map_aa_smooth <- make_smooth_map(Final_Risk_sf, "aa", "Amblyomma americanum")
map_dv_smooth <- make_smooth_map(Final_Risk_sf, "dv", "Dermacentor variabilis")
map_is_smooth <- make_smooth_map(Final_Risk_sf, "is", "Ixodes scapularis")

# View maps in RStudio viewer
map_aa_smooth
map_dv_smooth
map_is_smooth
```
